entries.zh: 真诚的敬意；诚敬（发自内心的尊敬）
entries.en: true honour; sincere reverence, genuine respect

entries.zh: 门风；家族的名誉与体面
entries.en: honour in the sense of family reputation; the good name of a household

entries.zh: 荣耀显赫；受人尊显
entries.en: honour and glory; illustriousness, high repute

entries.zh: 著名；声名显著
entries.en: famous, of note; renown
entries.notes: M 栏「hō miā līã」疑为「號名」连读，H「著名」与 L honra（声名）相合，末音节未详。

entries.zh: 普施（广施衣食财物于亡者与孤贫，为亡者作功德）
entries.en: to honour the dead by universal almsgiving (pu-shi, Buddhist charity on behalf of the deceased)

entries.zh: 普度（佛教普度亡魂的法事）
entries.en: universal deliverance of the dead (Buddhist rite, pu-du)

entries.zh: 向尊长鞠躬行礼
entries.en: to bow to one's elders and superiors

entries.zh: 恭敬；向人行礼致敬
entries.en: to show respect, to pay one's respects; to be reverent

entries.zh: 封赠；为祖先乞恩请封，光耀门第
entries.en: to confer honours on one's ancestors (feng-zeng); to do honour to one's lineage
entries.notes: L「fli naje」残讹，疑为 linaje（世系、门第）；H「封贈」与 M hóng chèng 一致，西语仅存残形。

entries.zh: 旌表；受朝廷赐匾立坊表彰（彰其德行于众）
entries.en: imperial commendation by inscribed tablet or honouring arch (jing-biao), publicly rewarding virtue
entries.notes: L 讹写严重（「los vintos los con honra tabla fleyda escrito」），然「tabla … escrito」正合旌表赐匾之事；H、M 一致。

entries.zh: 褒奖；以称扬赞美为敬
entries.en: to honour with praise; to commend, to extol

entries.zh: 奖励；嘉奖勉励
entries.en: to reward and encourage; to recompense with honour

entries.zh: 为家中亡者设祭供奉（设家祭以奉亡父先人）
entries.en: to honour the dead of one's household with ritual offerings; to set up ancestral offerings for a deceased father
entries.notes: L 缩写残损（「al fu. del P.e muertos」难解），H「設家臣」于义未安，M sŷ quē sin 疑读「祀家先」，故低置信。

entries.zh: 重阳节（九月九日祭祀亡者、登高避灾）
entries.en: the Double Ninth festival (9th day of the 9th moon), when the dead are commemorated

entries.zh: 昌；昌盛显贵（受人尊敬、门第高贵）
entries.en: honoured and noble; illustrious, of prosperous standing
entries.notes: M 栏后半混入西语「ynoble」，「sũn sūâ bô rio」未详，故仅据 H「昌」与 L 立义。

entries.zh: 名色；有名望、身份显要之人
entries.en: notable, of name and standing; a person of distinction

entries.zh: 好仪；仪容体面、有身份（一说音当作「好漢」）
entries.en: of good bearing and respectable appearance; possibly 'fine fellow' (hó-hàn)
entries.notes: M 作 hó hān，与 H「好儀」之 gî 不合而音近「好漢」，两栏抵牾，故降置信。

entries.zh: 昌盛；家业兴旺、富贵显达
entries.en: prosperous and flourishing; honoured, wealthy and noble

entries.zh: 大帽；显贵所戴的礼帽，转指有身份的人物
entries.en: the large ceremonial hat worn by persons of rank; by extension, a man of standing
entries.notes: H、M 均为大帽（tuā-bō）之实物名，L 之「受尊敬、富贵、高贵」须转读，故降置信。

entries.zh: 门面；体面排场、表面的风光
entries.en: outward show, 'face'; the appearance that commands respect
entries.notes: L「acude asnoblejacion」讹写难解；M 兼记 mūy bîn 与 Būn Bīn，示文白两读。

entries.zh: 气概；豪迈慷慨的气度
entries.en: magnanimous spirit, generous bearing; spirited and liberal-minded
